guideBoardBody: A shop's board lists a rate per gram for each purity, in RM. Check the purity and that the rate is per gram. The rate is for the gold itself; upah is usually charged on top.
guideBuiltBody: Price = weight × the shop's rate per gram + upah. The shop's rate is the gold's value plus its own mark-up. Paun splits a quote into gold and upah so you can see each part.
guidePurityBody: 916 is 22K gold, 91.6% pure, the usual purity for jewellery in Malaysia. 999 is almost pure 24K gold, sold as bars and coins. More gold in each gram means a higher price per gram.
guideStampsBody: A stamp such as 916, 22K or 750 is the maker's claim of how much of the piece is gold: 91.6%, about 22 parts in 24, or 75%. Ask the shop to write the purity on the receipt.
guideUpahBody: Upah pays for the making. It is charged per piece or per gram, and plain designs carry little. Upah is not returned when you sell or trade in; the gold is valued on weight and purity.
guideSusutBody: Susut is the percentage a shop takes off its selling rate when it buys gold back. Many shops post a buy-back rate per gram instead, which describes the same gap. Ask which one applies.
guideTradeinBody: Putting gold towards new jewellery often credits a little more than cash for the same gold. One dealer listed RM 490 per gram trade-in against RM 485 cash in October 2026. Ask for both offers.
guideTaxBody: Customers pay no sales tax on gold jewellery in Malaysia; the Treasury confirmed a zero rate in June 2025. Singapore charges 9% GST and the UAE 5% VAT, including on upah.
guideReceiptBody: Check the receipt shows: the item and its purity, the weight in grams, the day's rate per gram, upah on its own line, any stones, and the shop's exchange and buy-back terms.
guideUnitsBody: Malaysian shops quote RM per gram. A tahil is 37.5 g and a mayam about 3.33 g. A paun is about 8 g, a South Indian unit; Paun shows grams first and the paun as an extra line.
guideBankBody: Bank gold accounts sell 999.9 gold with no upah, with a gap between their buy and sell price of about 1% to 5.5%. Several settle in cash only. Public Gold's gap is about 7.5% (October 2026).
guideBuyBody: Ask for the rate per gram, the upah and the buy-back rate. Check that weight × rate + upah matches the total. Check price in Paun does that sum and splits gold from upah.
guideSellBody: Ask more than one shop for its buy-back rate or susut, and whether it takes any fee. Compare what you would receive, not the sticker price. Upah will not come back.
guideJobCheck: Check a price: does the shop's total add up?
guideJobSell: Sell or trade in: what should I get back?
guideJobCompare: Compare shops: who is cheapest, who pays most?
guideJobMine: My gold: what are my pieces worth today?
guideExampleBody: {{weight}} g of 916 at {{rate}} a gram, plus {{upah}} upah, comes to {{total}}. Sold back the same day at {{buyback}} a gram it fetches {{payout}}. The upah does not come back, so you are {{loss}} down.
